description: Exact tolerances for PRSG-011 mirrored migration guidance.

migration_guidance.row_count.rationale: Both paths must preserve the same runtime guidance rows.

migration_guidance.operation.rationale: Both surfaces name the same deferred runner operation without turning it into an invocation.

migration_guidance.promotion_status.rationale: Both surfaces must report the registry-backed deferred status.

migration_guidance.authoritative_request.rationale: Neither deferred operation has an authoritative request.

migration_guidance.guidance.rationale: Both surfaces report the gap and leave repository state unchanged.

tier2_matrix.action.rationale: Suggestion versus suppression behavior must not differ across paths.

tier2_matrix.reason.rationale: Skip and no-op reasons are part of the operator contract.

no_auto_run_guard.forbidden.rationale: Scaffold and autopilot must never auto-run Tier-2 relocation.
